result.summary: Found one clearly visible visual defect: a loading spinner is stuck over the Tokumaru Ramen Bar hero image, obscuring the food photo. A minor content redundancy also appears in that card's metadata. Clipped carousel items and the cut-off card at the bottom were excluded as intended features.

issues.description: A circular loading spinner remains displayed in the center of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar image, covering the food photo and suggesting the image or card has not finished loading.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the spinner is removed once the image loads, and add a placeholder or fallback image so the card never shows a persistent loading overlay.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card shows '€0 delivery' twice, once as a badge on the image and again in the metadata line, which is redundant.
issues.suggestion: Show the delivery fee in only one place on the card, such as the image badge or the metadata row.
